words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: A technique's `effects` list may hold {"name": <library Effect name>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}. When a build knows the technique at layer n or above (fight.py `tech_layers`, the GDScript FighterCompiler), the loader adds that Effect from assets/data/combat_effects.json and merges its counters. Matches Thiên Xu, Lạc Hà, Thủy Vị, and Phượng Minh's pending word of the same name.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp rule (passive arts): a technique may carry passive arts, each a named Effect with an unlock layer. Known to that layer, the passive art's Effect is always on in a fight; it takes no art slot and is never fired.
words.decision_reason: Matches the shared Stage 6 decision across batch a01/b01 ('build'). Both Not a Drop Spilled and Return to the Scabbard are staged in effects/thinh_vu.effects.json with this pending note until technique-effects is wired in the serial build step.

words.name: lint-requires-field
words.spec: Add "requires" to lint_arts.py FIELDS (already supported by fight.py and authored records in auth-tech.json) so root_lacks / root_requires gates like bronze-answers (root_lacks: ["loi"]) and the-chain-carries-it-down (root_has: ["loi"]) validate in staged arts.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp lineage rule: a canon with an elemental or root prerequisite may gate an art on what root the cultivator carries.
words.decision_reason: Matches phuong_minh's note on dawn-call: omit `requires` from the staged art JSON so lint_arts.py reports zero findings today, carry the gate text in `notes`, and restore `requires` once FIELDS in lint_arts.py allows it.

words.name: body-element-free-names
words.spec: Cross-owner note for xuyen_lam: calm-wind-staff-canon (and Xuyên Lâm's other techniques) are authored with `tech_kind: "main"` and `names: []` (element-free), which lint_techniques.py currently rejects (only `tech_kind: "body"` allows `names: []`). Either allow `names: []` on `main`/`secret` element-free schools or treat element-free staff/footwork schools under a dedicated flag.
words.gdd_text: Xuyên Lâm Môn lineage (R3): an element-free staff-and-footwork school whose main canon cultivates no element.
words.decision_reason: Early-promoted for uc_da_diep in foreign/xuyen_lam with temporary lint proxy `names: ["kim", "moc", "tho"]` (keeping `tech_kind: "main"` and element-free arts `element: ""`) so lint_techniques.py stays clean until xuyen_lam settles the schema.
